note: POST /submit in JSON and GET /s/{token}.json, written from mcp.tc's published contract (https://mcp.tc/docs/api#submit) with the site's own English texts, before the endpoint went live. The fake replaces https://mcp.tc with its own base URL, {token} with the token it made, and {slug} and {name} with the listing's.
